name: urlar-reel
_comment: Instagram Reels cut (1080x1920). Same renderer as urlar.config.json; run with --root pointing at the folder holding src/. Two source clips only — the original pilot.mp4/blend.mp4 are not on this machine, and there is no separate shoal pass, so the field segments are the same clip sampled at different crop windows.

safe._comment: Instagram Reels chrome, in final-output pixels. Caption stack and audio credit sit bottom-left, the action rail right, the top bar above. The end card pads to at least these insets and recentres inside what is left.

crop._comment: Crop-window position across the overflow the cover-scale leaves, 0..1. Default centre; each clip overrides. A 1280x720 source cover-scaled to 1080x1920 is 3413px wide, so x selects which 1080px column of that is kept — 2333px of travel. The instrument cluster sits at ~x1387 of the scaled frame, so x0.41 centres it in the safe box and x0.60+ pushes it off-frame for pure field.

timeline._note: Field leads. Instruments just off the left edge — environment, not performer.
The one brief shadowed glimmer, instruments centred in the safe box.
Field returns on a different column of the frame, so the reuse does not read as a loop.

audio._comment: Lightframe Part 1. in=55.9s is the floor of the trough at 55.75 (-22.75 dB RMS); the next phrase enters at 56.25, so the cut opens on the breath rather than mid-figure. Runs to 94.0s, a settle after the 92-93 peak. Both ends sit in troughs and the 3.5s fade lands on silence, so the Reel loops without a seam.

endCard.line2: Friday 4 December 2026 · House of Toad, Glasgow
